title: eMudhra to exit global SSL/TLS certificate business
why_read: A certificate authority shutting down its SSL/TLS business is a meaningful PKI ecosystem event worth understanding for anyone managing certificates.
analysis: eMudhra is a certificate authority, and CAs exiting the market usually follow trust violations, browser distrust actions, or compliance failures that are worth understanding for web security practitioners. This kind of event can force site operators to migrate certificates quickly and highlights the fragility and governance of the web's trust model. The large discussion volume implies there's a notable backstory, likely involving browser root program decisions.
